messages:
marie: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — I drafted an ops playbook for streaming/chat reliability. Summary: 3 near-term fixes (timeouts, reconnect heuristics, partial-response detection) and 2 platform tasks (KV-prefetching + improved tracing). Posting owners/timelines below, please ack and suggest changes.
aj: ACK. can you paste the short-term checklist inline so i can forward to infra?
marie: Sure — short-term items: 1) Reduce default server read timeout 30s->18s to fail fast on stalled connections. owner: kevin. due: 2026-04-05. 2) Implement client-visible reconnect hints + exponential jittered backoff (max 3 retries by default). owner: lia. due: 2026-03-30. 3) Add partial-response detection + circuit that triggers model-fallback for partial output patterns. owner: sam. due: 2026-04-12.
kevin: I can take the read-timeout change. Quick note: we need a canary on dedicated pool first, will run on dev/stage for 48h before prod rollout.
lia: Taking reconnect logic. Proposed default backoff config attached below.
lia: ```json
{"initial_delay_ms":200, "max_delay_ms":2000, "factor":2.0, "max_retries":3, "jitter":0.2}
```
marie: thanks — that config looks reasonable. can we surface the retry count and last_retry_time in tracing so console + alerts can pick it up?
sam: On partial-response detection: putting together a short eval to classify < 60% token stream completion vs expected. If flagged, we trigger fallback to a lighter model (gpt-like-quick) and mark the request as degraded. Will add metric names in the PR.
elaine: One ops ask — can we add an automatic ticket creation when the same client id hits 5 reconnects in 10 minutes? That pattern was a major signal in the incident.
marie: Good idea. That should be a separate small automation task. owner: marie. due: 2026-03-28.
kevin: For the canary: I'll add a release note and a quick rollback plan. Also need a telemetry dashboard tile for "read_timeout_triggers" and "stream_reconnect_rate".
aj: Please add the dashboard tiles to the runbook so oncall can eyeball during the rollout.
marie: Will do. medium-term items: A) KV-prefetching for likely next-token contexts to reduce partials (research) owner: sam. due: 2026-05-10. B) End-to-end trace propagation into customer-visible latency breakdowns to detect network vs model stalls. owner: elaine. due: 2026-05-24.
sam: Noting a recurring pattern across 3 incidents: long-tail requests with spike in seq_len + sudden client disconnect. Suggest we add a histogram for seq_len by reconnects to see correlation.
marie: Agreed. action: sam to add histogram metric name `seq_len_on_reconnect` and a weekly alert if >10% of reconnects have seq_len > 1024. due: 2026-04-02.
sam: added to my list.
kevin: Minor implementation note for the read timeout change — there are two places: grpc edge and http proxy. I'll open two PRs and link them in this thread.
marie: Ownership recap: kevin (read timeout + canary), lia (reconnect heuristics), sam (partial detection + metric + KV research), elaine (trace propagation + automation), marie (ticket automation + runbook updates). Weekly sync on Fridays at 11am for the next 6 weeks to close the loop.
aj: acked. Friday sync works.
incident-bot: Incident #442 — closed. summary: streaming partial responses due to reconnection loops. timeline + logs uploaded to /incidents/442.
marie: One last ask — please drop short status updates to this thread when a PR is opened/merged or canary starts. Short messages only (PR link or :thumbsup:).
kevin: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/2345 — will post canary start.
lia: PR opened for reconnect middleware: https://git.internal/r/2352. testing today.
sam: Draft PR for partial-detection tests: https://git.internal/r/2361. running evals tonight.
marie: Thanks all. Appreciated quick turn. We'll reconvene Friday. If anything blocks owners, ping me or @aj. :thumbsup:
